title: vetiveria filipes var. arundinacea
intro: Vetiveria filipes var. arundinacea, commonly known as vetiver grass, is a type of plant native to tropical Asia. It is known for its roots, which are used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and reduce stress. The health benefits of vetiver grass include its ability to improve sleep quality, reduce anxiety, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of vetiver grass can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative properties.
